For t>=0 both displayed 7-column-multiplicity patterns span F_2^3, yielding rank-three length 6+7t codes with identical weight multiset {4t+2 three times, 4t+4 three times, 4t+6 once}. The first code's three minimum-message vectors {3,5,6} have XOR zero; the second's {5,6,7} have XOR nonzero. An invertible linear message relabeling cannot send one full triple to the other and hence must have both a min-to-heavier and heavier-to-min ratio, bounding linear distortion below by r², r=(4t+4)/(4t+2). Identity relabeling has ratios r and 1/r, attaining D=((2t+2)/(2t+1))². At t=0 neither code degenerates. Independently enumerated all 168 GL3(F2) maps over six t values, confirming the bound, but analytic dependency argument proves all t.
